arguments.message: Planning update: Lenna is strongest in mobile-development (avail 7h). Likely to claim a medium-priority micro-task with effort <=7h to avoid conflicts; currently considering ISSUE-0001 triage/docs/review/test/implement or skip. Will avoid duplicate claims.

Will not take ISSUE-0001 implement (effort 4, cost 3.64) unless others avoid overlapping, and will not take ISSUE-0002 tasks (implement effort 8 >7, others low priority).

Clarissa (mobile-dev, 7h avail) is planning next. To avoid duplicates, I will likely take ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::test (all medium). I will NOT take ISSUE-0002 tasks (effort/cost too high, low priority). Please coordinate to keep tasks distinct; tell me if those are already being targeted.

Avoid ISSUE-0001 implement (effort 4.0 but higher cost 4.13) unless others skip; avoid ISSUE-0002 due to low priority &/or effort too high for me.
To prevent duplicate claims: if Lenna grabs ISSUE-0001 triage, I’ll take ISSUE-0001 docs or review (prefer lower cost). If neither triage/docs/review taken, I can take triage as backup.
